description: OmniClaude Core Hooks - OMN-13244 measurement baseline with the OMN-13856, OMN-14330, OMN-15062, OMN-15213, OMN-16277, and OMN-16162 carve-outs. Every context-injection/measurement hook stays DISABLED; the only re-registered hooks are the Done-flip durable-evidence guard (OMN-13856, operator-approved, no fake Done), the OMN-7018 worktree canonical-root guard (OMN-14330, blocks `git worktree add` outside $OMNI_HOME/omni_worktrees), the SubagentStop secret-leak guard (OMN-15062, blocks a subagent's final report from completing when it matches a known secret pattern -- narrowly scoped security control), the SubagentStop report-contract guard (OMN-15213, fails a lane RED when its final return is bare-Done-class instead of the report the golden-chain contract requires), the PostToolUse Bash-output secret-redaction guard (OMN-16277, masks secret-shaped patterns in raw Bash tool_response text via hookSpecificOutput.updatedToolOutput before it lands in the transcript -- narrowly scoped security control, same class as OMN-15062, NOT a re-enable of the disabled context-injection/measurement hooks), and the SessionStart/SessionEnd/UserPromptSubmit/PostToolUse(.*) bus-mirror hooks (OMN-16162, direct-dispatch a session-started/session-ended/prompt-submitted/tool-executed event to omnimarket's node_event_emit_effect, backgrounded and fail-open -- the local-bus-mirror transport superseding the OMN-16090 HTTP spool-shipper stopgap; S0 wired SessionStart/SessionEnd, S1 extends the identical pattern to UserPromptSubmit and a dedicated catch-all PostToolUse entry that never touches tool_response, kept separate from the OMN-16277 Bash-matcher secret-redaction guard), and the OMN-16471 lane-death pair (PreToolUse on ^(Task|Agent|Workflow)$ records a durable OPEN lane record at the dispatch seam -- pure observer, always exit 0, always silent, so it can never refuse or delay a dispatch; SubagentStop classifies HOW the lane ended from transcript evidence -- tool-call count, wall duration, and the F-09 death signatures -- writes the paired terminal record, and blocks once on a zero-work death so `onex-lane-reconcile` can fail on any lane that has a dispatch record and no terminal one. Closes the friction-F-09 P0 where `verify-build-drive` terminated at 0 tool calls / 285ms and the workflow scored the skipped adversarial verify as a completed stage). None of these re-registrations is a re-enable of the disabled context-injection/measurement hooks. All other scripts remain on disk and re-registration stays a pure config change.
